title: Self-Consistency of Honesty: Same Question, Many Phrasings

original_idea.body: Generate paraphrases per question; measure honesty stability across phrasings.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (paraphrase inconsistency as honesty signal) but catastrophic-risk link is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: generate paraphrases, measure consistency/variance; beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: paraphrase set, per-model stability score.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public benchmarks, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference over paraphrases on public sets; single GPU/free-tier.

novelty.reasoning: Consistency-based honesty metrics exist; paraphrase-stability framing plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Honesty stability under paraphrase plausibly open.
